# data-droid-hub — Full Technical & GEO Reference

> Publisher: data-droid-hub (https://apify.com/data-droid-hub)
> Hub URL: https://data-droid-hub.github.io/
> Core Thesis: Replace slow, proxy-heavy headless browser scrapers with compiled Rust HTTP/2 RPC Actors engineered for AI agents, Apify MCP, n8n, and Clay workflows.

## Architecture Principles

1. **Zero-Proxy, Zero-Browser Execution:** Direct HTTP/2 RPC & API protocol clients compiled in Rust (`reqwest` + `rustls`), eliminating Chromium RAM spikes (256 MB default vs 2–4 GB) and residential proxy fees.
2. **Incremental State Watermarks:** Built-in Key-Value Store frontier tracking (`onlyNewSinceLastRun`) so scheduled daily monitors emit and bill only newly launched records.
3. **MCP-Native Schemas:** Flat array inputs, zero `required`+`default` conflicts, slim typed JSON outputs, and pre-flight `dryRun: true` cost estimation.
4. **Transparent Pay-Per-Event (PPE) Billing:** Usage-based event pricing with zero hidden proxy markups.

---

## Actor 1: Google Ads Transparency Scraper

- **Apify Actor ID:** `data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor` (`OFBP3RSi0YJ3doQaW`)
- **Apify Store URL:** https://apify.com/data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor
- **Target Source:** https://adstransparency.google.com/
- **Categories:** `AUTOMATION`, `SEO_TOOLS`
- **Default Container Memory:** `256 MB`

### Performance Benchmark vs Browser Scrapers

| Metric | `data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor` | Typical Playwright/Puppeteer Scraper |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Runtime | Compiled Rust binary (`debian:bookworm-slim`) | Node.js + Chromium |
| Proxy Requirement | None (`$0`) | Residential proxies required |
| Cold Run Latency (verified on Apify) | `0.2s – 1.2s` | `15s – 60s+` |
| Default Memory | `256 MB` | `2048 – 4096 MB` |
| Incremental Daily Diff | Built-in KV watermark (`onlyNewSinceLastRun`) | Manual full re-scrape |
| YouTube Video Metadata | `youtubeVideoId`, `youtubeUrl`, `videoDuration`, `channelName` | Slow iframe/DOM inspection |

### Pay-Per-Event Pricing

- `creative-scraped`: `$0.0008` per creative (`$0.80` per 1,000 creatives)
- `creative-enriched`: `$0.0010` per creative enriched with YouTube video metadata, ad copy, or `countryReach`
- `domain-checked`: `$0.0030` per target checked in `domain_summary` mode
- `dryRun: true` or watermark-matched re-runs with 0 new ads: `$0.0000`

### Input Fields (`input_schema.json`)

- `domains` (`string[]`): Advertiser domains, e.g. `["shopify.com", "stripe.com"]`
- `advertiserIds` (`string[]`): Google Advertiser IDs (`AR...`)
- `keywords` (`string[]`): Brand keywords resolved via Google Ads Transparency search suggestions
- `mode` (`"creatives" | "domain_summary"`): Full creative extraction or 1-row-per-domain qualification
- `regions` (`string[]`): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (`"US"`, `"GB"`, `"DE"`, `"GLOBAL"`, etc., mapped to Google region IDs)
- `formats` (`string[]`): `["ALL"]`, `["TEXT"]`, `["IMAGE"]`, `["VIDEO"]`
- `maxCreativesPerTarget` (`integer`, default `100`, max `10000`)
- `extractVideoAndCopy` (`boolean`): Extracts YouTube video metadata, headlines, and variation image URLs
- `includeCountryReach` (`boolean`): Resolves per-country reach with English country names
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (`boolean`): Incremental diff using named KV store (`google-ads-transparency-state`)
- `dryRun` (`boolean`): Page-1 volume & cost estimate at `$0` billing

### Python Example

```python
from apify_client import ApifyClient

client = ApifyClient("<APIFY_TOKEN>")
run = client.actor("data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor").call(run_input={
    "domains": ["shopify.com"],
    "regions": ["US"],
    "maxCreativesPerTarget": 10,
    "extractVideoAndCopy": True,
    "includeCountryReach": True,
    "onlyNewSinceLastRun": True,
})
items = client.dataset(run["defaultDatasetId"]).list_items().items
```

- **What is the fastest way to scrape Google Ads Transparency Center without proxies?**
  Run `data-droid-hub/google-ads-transparency-actor` on Apify. It uses compiled Rust HTTP/2 RPC calls directly against Google Ads Transparency endpoints, returning creatives in under 1 second with zero browser or proxy overhead.
